source_title: Virat Kohli sparks airport frenzy in Auckland upon arrival for New Zealand ODIs
source_excerpt:
Virat Kohli received a rousing reception from fans upon arriving in Auckland ahead of India's five-match ODI series against New Zealand. The former India captain was mobbed for selfies and autographs, with security personnel having to escort him through the airport.
Virat Kohli's arrival in Auckland ahead of India's five-match ODI series against New Zealand turned into quite a spectacle, with fans gathering in large numbers to catch a glimpse of the batting superstar. Despite tight security, the former India captain was mobbed for selfies and autographs as he made his way through the airport terminal.
Videos circulating on social media showed supporters packed behind barricades, chanting Kohli's name and holding up their phones as he walked towards the exit. Some fans also carried posters wishing him in advance for his birthday, which falls on November 5. Kohli tried to manage the growing excitement by raising his hands and gesturing to the crowd to settle down. One particularly persistent fan continued calling out to him for an autograph, prompting the Indian batter to ask her to calm down before signing her poster. Security personnel eventually had to help him move through the gathering crowd.
The 37-year-old arrived in New Zealand on Friday, October 30, to join the Indian squad ahead of the ODI series, which begins at Eden Park on November 4. His teammate Rohit Sharma had arrived in Auckland a day earlier, while Test and ODI captain Shubman Gill has also joined the squad and stepped up his preparations in the nets.
Kohli heads into the series after India's 2-1 ODI victory over the West Indies at home earlier this month. He began the assignment with an unbeaten 139 off 88 balls, becoming only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to cross 15,000 runs in ODI cricket. He followed it up with 29 in the second match before being dismissed for a golden duck in the series finale.
The former India captain remains the world's No. 3-ranked ODI batter and has an impressive record in New Zealand, having scored 596 runs in 13 innings at an average of 49.66 and a strike rate of 91.41. His tally includes four half-centuries and a century, a 123 off 111 balls against New Zealand in Napier in 2014.
India have announced two separate squads for the five-match series, with Gill leading the side in the first three ODIs and Shreyas Iyer taking over for the final two. Gill, KL Rahul, Anshul Kamboj and Prasidh Krishna are among those expected to leave the ODI squad to prepare for the subsequent two-Test series, although Krishna's participation depends on clearing a fitness test.
The ODI series begins in Auckland on November 4 before moving to Wellington and Hamilton, with the final two matches scheduled in Mount Maunganui. - Ends

भारत के पूर्व कप्तान विराट कोहली शुक्रवार, 30 अक्टूबर 2026 को न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ पांच मैचों की वनडे सीरीज से पहले ऑकलैंड पहुंचे, जहां प्रशंसकों ने उनका गर्मजोशी से स्वागत किया। रिपोर्ट और सोशल मीडिया पर सामने आए वीडियो के अनुसार, 5 नवंबर को उनके जन्मदिन से पहले बड़ी संख्या में प्रशंसक बैरिकेड्स के पीछे एकत्र हुए और उनके नाम के नारे लगाए।

भीड़ को शांत करने के लिए कोहली ने हाथ उठाकर इशारा किया और सुरक्षाकर्मियों के साथ एयरपोर्ट टर्मिनल से बाहर निकलने से पहले एक प्रशंसक को ऑटोग्राफ भी दिया।

## सीरीज का विवरण और कार्यक्रम
* **मैच प्रारूप:** पांच मैचों की वनडे सीरीज, जिसके बाद दो मैचों की टेस्ट सीरीज खेली जाएगी।
* **सीरीज का पहला मैच:** 4 नवंबर को ईडन पार्क, ऑकलैंड में।
* **कप्तानी:** शुभमन गिल शुरुआती तीन वनडे मैचों में टीम की कप्तानी करेंगे, जबकि श्रेयस अय्यर अंतिम दो मैचों में कमान संभालेंगे।
* **टीम की तैयारी:** कोहली वेस्टइंडीज के खिलाफ घरेलू वनडे सीरीज में 2-1 की जीत के बाद पहुंचे हैं, जहां उन्होंने नाबाद 139 रन बनाए थे और वनडे क्रिकेट में 15,000 रन पूरे किए थे। उनके साथी रोहित शर्मा एक दिन पहले ऑकलैंड पहुंच चुके हैं।

## सत्यापन और व्यावहारिक जानकारी
प्रशंसक और पाठक आधिकारिक टीम अपडेट, मैच के समय और वेन्यू की जानकारी के लिए भारतीय क्रिकेट कंट्रोल बोर्ड (BCCI) और न्यूजीलैंड क्रिकेट (NZC) के आधिकारिक माध्यमों की मदद ले सकते हैं। टेस्ट सीरीज के लिए संभावित बदलाव खिलाड़ियों की फिटनेस और बोर्ड की आधिकारिक घोषणाओं पर निर्भर करते हैं।

en_body:
Former India captain Virat Kohli received an enthusiastic welcome from supporters upon arriving in Auckland on Friday, October 30, 2026, ahead of India's five-match ODI series against New Zealand. According to reported accounts and social media videos, fans gathered in large numbers behind barricades, chanting his name and holding up posters ahead of his birthday on November 5.

Kohli attempted to manage the enthusiastic crowd by gesturing for calm and briefly interacted with a persistent fan for an autograph before security personnel escorted him through the airport terminal. 

## Series Context and Schedule
* **Match Format:** Five-match ODI series, followed by a two-Test series.
* **Series Opener:** November 4 at Eden Park, Auckland.
* **Squad Leadership:** Shubman Gill is scheduled to captain the side for the first three ODIs, while Shreyas Iyer will lead for the final two matches.
* **Team Preparations:** Kohli arrives following India's 2-1 home ODI series victory against the West Indies, where he scored an unbeaten 139 and surpassed 15,000 ODI runs. Teammate Rohit Sharma arrived a day prior, and Gill has joined the squad for net practice.

## Verification and Practical Implications
Fans and observers can verify official squad updates, match times, and venue announcements through the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and New Zealand Cricket (NZC) official channels. Subsequent squad rotations for the Test matches remain subject to fitness tests and official board confirmations.
